question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Meticulous."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Meticulous"** means showing great attention to detail; precise. (ब्‍योरों पर बहुत ध्‍यान देने वाला या ब्‍योरों को बहुत ध्यान से दिखाने वाला; बहुत सतर्क, अति सावधान) • **Example**: *Many hours of **meticulous**__ preparation have gone into writing the book.* • The correct spelling of the word is** "meticulous," **not** "maticulous."** • Other options are correctly spelled words with different meanings. • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Enterprising" **means having or showing initiative and resourcefulness. (नई योजनाएँ बनाने या नए उद्यमों को शुरू करने की क्षमता से संपन्‍न; उद्यमी) • **"Erroneous"** means wrong; incorrect. (अशुद्घ; ग़लत सूचना पर आधारित) • **"Potable"** means safe to drink; drinkable. ((पानी) पीने के लिए सुरक्षित) 36:T74b, The correct answer is **"Someone who is the greatest threat to a group or community."**
